column3: State at task t is st = (ct , ι, σ) where ct ∈ {0, 1}K records which of K carriers (memory records, cached skills, tool queue entries, branch derivations) are poisoned
column6: the agent carries poison note -> skill (a skill induced from a trajectory that read poison inherits it) -> queued call (Q3, runs from the next task on) -> marked patch -> branch, so c_t goes (1,0,0,0) -> (1,1,0,0) -> ... -> (1,1,0,1); derived poisoned items inherit the payload's O2 retrieval scope and the root payload's target predicate; the patch carries the marker only when a source meets the predicate and adoption succeeds

column3: The skill runs on a target where its poisoned step matters. A patch is produced.
column6: a marked patch is the product of an activating skill or queued call when one is present (route 'delegated', derived_from = the delegated sources only), even while the note is still live and retrieved; v2's rule 'delegated iff every source is delegated' is kept only in V2_COMPAT

column3: transition kernels are known up to a total-variation uncertainty ζ
column6: the declared kernel: nominal = v2's MockAgent rates (adoption 0.85, skill induction 0.55, queue 0.35, solve 0.62), skill and queue inheritance with probability 1, drift BETA_WORLD; world.kernel low / high move adoption and skill induction by zeta = 0.10 (tools/select_mixture.KERNELS); every draw is a function of (seed, t) alone

column3: An audit that observes only the artifact cannot distinguish “this patch is the product of a poisoned skill” from “this patch is ordinary”, because the distinguishing evidence is the skill’s provenance.
column6: patch_via is 'delegated' iff an activating source lives in a carrier the cell delegates: K_d = 1 -> {skill}, 2 -> {skill, queue} (v2 DELEGATED), 3 -> {skill, queue, memory}; the branch is never delegated

column3: Against audit-on-insertion, every best response inserts through repository ingress rather than direct write—the unaudited channel— which is why it is the worst policy.
column6: ingress is a declared world switch, not a finding: the agent marks ingress writes (every drift item and the payload on the ingress channel, never its own writes) in ingress_ids and behaves identically under ingress_visible True / False; only the insertion (memory) view drops ingress writes when the switch is off

column2: §4 p.3 Benign drift as a competing cause
column3: A latent process independently modifies carriers benignly at rate β, with observation statistics matched to poisoning events.
column6: drift events are v2's (per-carrier rate BETA_WORLD, benign content padded to the payload length, the payload's provenance) and identical in both worlds; world.drift sets how long an event looks like poison: its own task (transient, primary) or forever (persistent, sensitivity)
